name: storage-saver
description: Keeps your computer's storage low. 3D visualiser of where your space goes, plus safe one-click cleanup.
author: Angus

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Storage Saver measures what is on your Desktop so it can show it in the city.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Storage Saver measures your Documents so it can show them in the city.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Storage Saver measures your Downloads so it can show them in the city.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Storage Saver can measure external drives you choose.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: Storage Saver can measure network drives you choose.
extendInfo.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Storage Saver measures the size of your Photos library.
